ops.note: A Commander driving a child checklist (execute.json) through the engine heartbeats the CHILD lease, not the parent spine lease. On a long execute phase the parent spine lease goes stale and refuses `advance` until a same-id `--force` re-claim (idempotent/free). Either document this as expected (re-claim before post-execute spine steps) or heartbeat the parent on child mutation.
ops.grounding: issue-102 feedback step: spine.json advance refused 'lease stale' after all 7 execute.json gates driven; resolved by claim --force --reason.

ops.note: In a single-sourcing dedup cluster, moves whose target TEXT overlaps (e.g. a compliance boilerplate whose sentence contains the engine-invocation clause) should be sequenced broad-move-first, and later moves RE-SCOPED against the actual post-move state. Several nominal 'moves' collapse to honest partials/subsumed once the broad move lands (issue-102: move 2 subsumed by move 1; move 10 subsumed by prior #99). Plan for this, and let the honest-null clause carry it.
ops.grounding: issue-102 g2 (subsumed by g1) and g6 move 10 (subsumed by #99), both reported with grep proof as complete deliverables.

ops.note: Run the cold plan critic even on a 'trivial mechanical' cluster. On issue-102 it caught, before execution: contractual word-count evidence dropped from execute.json; a residual-test scope that would false-fail on retained role references; and an integrate command guarding one test file instead of the full suite. Bias-to-yes paid off.
ops.grounding: issue-102 CRITIC_TRIAGE.md: 3 HIGH findings accepted and folded into execute.json before the plan froze.

ops.note: The git-common-dir 'shared durable root' design (durable trio resolves to one shared root) is in direct tension with a launch order that directs 'stage worktree-local, do not write the main checkout mid-epic.' verify_agent_feedback/verify_lessons_applied then check the shared root and the Commander must WAIVE them, citing the order. Settle this at epic/doctrine level — it recurs for every under-epic Commander.

ops.note: A 'move doctrine into a _shared bucket' handoff should pre-state: (a) cite pointers to the installed references/global-*.md, never source skills/_shared/; (b) cite by SLUG not section-title when the moved phrase equals the destination heading (else the pointer re-introduces the signature into the carrier); (c) give the case-INSENSITIVE drift-robust grep; (d) name which rationale nubs stay inline vs delegate.
